		<script data-startup-endpoint="https%3A%2F%2Fapi.datezone.com%2Fv3%2Fsystem%2Freact-error">(() => {
	try {
		const endpoint = decodeURIComponent(
			document.currentScript.getAttribute("data-startup-endpoint"),
		);
		let stopped = false;

		const cleanUrl = (value) => {
			if (!value) return null;
			try {
				const url = new URL(value, window.location.href);
				const pathname = url.pathname.replace(
					/^(\/registration[^/?#]*\/[^/?#]+\/[^/?#]+\/)[^/?#]+/i,
					"$1[UKRYTE]",
				);
				return `${url.origin}${pathname}`.slice(0, 512);
			} catch {
				return null;
			}
		};

		const isOwnScript = (value) => {
			if (!value) return false;
			try {
				const url = new URL(value, window.location.href);
				return (
					url.origin === window.location.origin &&
					url.pathname.startsWith("/assets/") &&
					/\.m?js$/.test(url.pathname)
				);
			} catch {
				return false;
			}
		};

		const cleanText = (value, limit) =>
			String(value || "")
				.replace(/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+/g, (url) => cleanUrl(url) || "")
				.slice(0, limit);

		const findScriptUrl = (value) => {
			const urls = String(value || "").match(
				/https?:\/\/[^\s"'<>]+?\.m?js(?:[?#][^\s"'<>]*)?/g,
			);
			return urls?.find(isOwnScript) || null;
		};

		const resources = () => {
			try {
				if (
					typeof window.performance?.getEntriesByType !== "function"
				) {
					return {
						resource_timing_available: false,
						resource_entries: [],
					};
				}
				const entries = window.performance
					.getEntriesByType("resource")
					.filter((entry) => isOwnScript(entry.name));
				return {
					resource_timing_available: true,
					resource_entries_truncated: entries.length > 100,
					resource_entries: entries.slice(-100).map((entry) => ({
						url: cleanUrl(entry.name),
						start_ms: entry.startTime ?? null,
						duration_ms: entry.duration ?? null,
						response_status: entry.responseStatus || null,
						transfer_bytes: entry.transferSize ?? null,
						encoded_bytes: entry.encodedBodySize ?? null,
						decoded_bytes: entry.decodedBodySize ?? null,
					})),
				};
			} catch {
				return {
					resource_timing_available: false,
					resource_entries: [],
				};
			}
		};

		const send = (kind, message, error, url, line, column) => {
			try {
				if (stopped) return;
				stop();

				const data = {
					from: "startup_logger",
					route: cleanUrl(window.location.href),
					error: cleanText(
						message || "Startup module failed to load",
						500,
					),
					error_stack: cleanText(error?.stack, 1000),
					client_time: new Date().toISOString(),
					user_agent: String(window.navigator?.userAgent || "").slice(
						0,
						512,
					),
					startup_diagnostics: {
						kind,
						script_url: url ? cleanUrl(url) : null,
						line: Number.isFinite(line) ? line : null,
						column: Number.isFinite(column) ? column : null,
						entry_script_url: cleanUrl(
							document.querySelector('script[type="module"][src]')
								?.src || "",
						),
						page_age_ms: window.performance?.now?.() ?? null,
						visibility_state: document.visibilityState,
						...resources(),
					},
				};
				let body = JSON.stringify(data);
				while (new window.Blob([body]).size > 32 * 1024) {
					if (data.startup_diagnostics.resource_entries.length) {
						data.startup_diagnostics.resource_entries.shift();
						data.startup_diagnostics.resource_entries_truncated = true;
					} else if (data.error_stack) {
						data.error_stack = "";
					} else {
						return;
					}
					body = JSON.stringify(data);
				}

				const options = {
					method: "POST",
					credentials: "omit",
					headers: {
						Accept: "application/api.1.0+json",
						"Content-Type": "application/json",
					},
					body,
				};
				if (window.Request && "keepalive" in window.Request.prototype) {
					options.keepalive = true;
				}
				window.fetch(endpoint, options).catch(() => {});
			} catch {
				// Awaria diagnostyki nie może przerwać uruchamiania aplikacji.
			}
		};

		const onError = (event) => {
			try {
				const target = event.target;
				// WebKit zgłasza brak eksportu bez adresu pliku i stosu.
				const missingExportWithoutUrl =
					!event.filename &&
					event.error?.name === "SyntaxError" &&
					/^SyntaxError: Importing binding name .+ is not found\.$/.test(
						event.message || "",
					);
				if (target?.tagName === "SCRIPT" && isOwnScript(target.src)) {
					send("module_load", null, null, target.src);
				} else if (
					isOwnScript(event.filename) ||
					missingExportWithoutUrl
				) {
					send(
						"script_error",
						event.message,
						event.error,
						event.filename,
						event.lineno,
						event.colno,
					);
				}
			} catch {
				// Obcy obiekt błędu nie może wywołać kolejnego wyjątku.
			}
		};

		const onRejection = (event) => {
			try {
				const reason = event.reason;
				const url =
					findScriptUrl(reason?.stack) ||
					findScriptUrl(reason?.message);
				if (url)
					send("unhandled_rejection", reason?.message, reason, url);
			} catch {
				// Obcy obiekt odrzucenia nie może uszkodzić loggera.
			}
		};
		const stop = () => {
			stopped = true;
			try {
				window.removeEventListener("error", onError, true);
				window.removeEventListener("unhandledrejection", onRejection);
				window.removeEventListener("pagehide", stop);
			} catch {
				// Flaga blokuje raportowanie również po nieudanym usunięciu nasłuchów.
			}
		};

		window.__DZ_STARTUP_LOGGER__ = { stop };
		window.addEventListener("error", onError, true);
		window.addEventListener("unhandledrejection", onRejection);
		window.addEventListener("pagehide", stop);
	} catch {
		// Logger jest opcjonalny, również przy ograniczonych API przeglądarki.
	}
})();
</script>
